design_section: PROPOSAL: SSH child authority under supported interruption (2026-10-09)
limits: No kernel-level terminal-wait bound or guarantee for arbitrary asynchronous Exception subclasses, uncatchable termination or host failure.
Supported interruption propagates after cleanup; no normal scan/trust success or generic invocation-error mapping.
Deadline, output bounds, native stream/status/diagnostics, trust/lifecycle/schema/runner/source/capture/pins remain unchanged.
No local checks or process/lifecycle execution; all new regressions are prepared, not passed.
Review9 remains on its original committed objects.
Both incomplete G4/G6 campaigns and all private resources/other repositories remain untouched.
prose: Root-owned runtime-contract remains byte-identical; no factual mismatch or required product-copy change identified.
remedy: SSH-only supported SignalException masking at cleanup-visible pipe/PID acquisition, each real wait/status/authority transition and in-boundary ECHILD invalidation, forced/ensure cleanup with inner endpoint closure. Ordinary loop/select/read remains interruptible.
source_supported_problem: Previously spawn-to-local assignment and successful wait/status/PID-clear were interruptible; ensure could miss a spawned child or signal a reaped PID. No real reuse or unrelated signal observed.
